title: 第六十六回 正宫夺位第六十五回 陵中凶影
slug: 驭音心经第七十回狼心逞乱
lines: “且慢！”
随太监入宫听宣的世子奇，走过王府曲廊，突然叫住迎面避让一人。
“你是何人？怎的我以前未曾见过？”
来人手拎食盒，蹲了一个万福，语声娇媚，听得世子奇心头一酥：“回王爷，奴婢文秀，是容妃娘娘身前侍女。新近才选入宫，王爷故而不知。”
“哦，原来如此。”世子奇口中应着，脚却未停，随太监匆匆而去。内心却如一面湖镜，被蓦然掠入一只蓝翠，搅得涟漪层层，心绪难宁。
“莫非我灵力消退？”
孤鹤雁静坐练功，施驭音传声之法，召唤坐骑云豹蘑菇，却始终不见其现身。他喃喃自语：“自遭鬽蠹子侵入，连记忆都缺损三分，难道真如四皇子所言，还须修养几日，待灵力恢复，再思报仇？”
“唉……，不知爷爷、蘑菇、小诗丐他们现今如何？”孤鹤雁合目长叹，脑海中又浮现出他与师父的深谈。
被那鬽蠹子侵入噬魂吞灵，孤鹤雁如被鬼魅牵引，坠入无底黑洞之中，不断下坠，身不由己。恍惚间，他只觉神魂离体，周围身影绰绰，犹是向他走来。
“是卉云吗？”他问，人影晃动，却不应。“是奶奶吗？是爷爷吗？……”人影亦是晃动不答。直到他悲泣出声，一个犹似师父的人影走了出来，孤鹤雁迎上前欲抱住，却又扑了空。
孤鹤雁勉力大喊：“师父，是你吗？你去了哪儿？徒儿来寻你了。”
师父慧觉莞尔，空灵的回音在黑暗中回荡：“鹤雁，为师哪也没有去，为师只是在探究我自己。”
孤鹤雁再问：“师父，人死后，一家人还能再团聚吗？”
“我想念卉云，想念奶奶，亦想念你！”
师父轻轻一笑：“傻孩子，净说胡话！你不会有事。你只是被邪毒侵入，一时虚弱，神思混沌，坠入幻境罢了。”
“师父，世上真有能吞噬一切、深不见底，连神仙都惧怕的黑洞吗？”
“师父，你见到师伯没有？”
就这时，一个丫鬟手拎食盒步入室内，打断他的思绪：“孤仙人，容妃娘娘遣我送你一口酥。”
“多谢。还请转告容妃，莫要再送，太多了。”孤鹤雁含笑叮咛。
“奴婢记下了。”来人蹲了一个万福：“娘娘说，孤仙人身体尚需调养，但有可口之物，她都会尝过再遣奴婢送来。还请仙人莫要推辞，能吃尽吃。”言罢，抬头轻看孤鹤雁一眼，迅疾又低下头。
见那蓝宝石般瞳眸，孤鹤雁心头一动，暗忖：“此女好生眼熟……似曾哪里见过？”口中道：“如此便是谢了。请转告容妃，若她身体适宜，我当亲往致谢。”言罢暗自回想，却始终记不起何时见过此人，无奈摇头，低叹一声：“唉，鬽蠹子害我不浅，诸多事竟忆不起！”
四皇子命世子奇，以父子之礼，参拜孤鹤雁，并谆谆嘱咐：“奇儿，你待孤仙人要如待朕，凡事皆听吩咐，断不可无礼！”世子奇岂敢违逆，连声允诺。
回到王府，世子奇大吐苦水：“……凡事只回应个是，如今可好，劳军宣谕，甩都甩不掉的苦差事！叫我如何是好？”
苏努闻言一笑，劝：“殿下此言差矣！”
“比起守灵哭丧，坐困深宫，钦差大臣，那该是美差才是！”
世子奇微微颔首：“这倒也是。”
“不过话说回来，那地方穷山恶水，蛮荒未化，只怕少不得要吃些苦头。若是于路能带上灵猴，便好了。”
苏努正欲劝阻，世子奇忽一击掌：“对了！今日撞见一女子，姿色出众。苏努，你必须为我谋一计，让我于路带上她。”
苏努笑：“敢问殿下，是哪家女子？”
“容妃娘娘身前近侍，小名阿秀。”
“这……”苏努一蹙眉：“只有一天，怕是不成！”
世子奇脸色一沉，掏出鼻烟壶鼻吸一口，阴声道：“好好想，还有一天。成，要赏得赏。不成，我便发配你去叶城！让你比我还苦闷！”
是夜，四王妃携重礼，造访慈安宫，探望容月。
容月迎出宫门，满面惊诧：“皇后娘娘若有吩咐，遣人来便是，如何亲走一趟？此事若叫皇上知晓，臣妾如何担待得起？”
四王妃微微一笑：“容妃言过。”
“容妃与孤仙人，如今是皇上身边最得眷顾之人，谁人不知，谁人不晓？”
“常言道母以子贵，容妃如今有孕在身，来日岂可限量？本宫既为皇后，理当亲来探望。若不如此，岂不叫皇上怪我不识大体？”
容月作势要拜，被四王妃一把拉住。四王妃挽住其手，直若姐妹一般步入慈安宫，边走边道：“咱姐妹何必拘那些虚礼，平白让人看了生分！”容月连声道：“岂敢，岂敢！姐姐是皇后，我是嫔妃，一应礼节还是要的。”
“唉……”闻此言，四王妃竟取出手帕抹起眼，一副伤怀心酸之状。
“姐姐这是怎的？叫妹妹看得心慌。”容月惊问。
四王妃将手绢一收：“哎，都被妹妹看破，我也真是沉不住气。难怪外面人说，你才是宫里的正主，我们娘儿俩早晚要让位！”
容月闻听脸色煞白，当即跪倒：“皇后娘娘折煞奴婢！……”话音未落，泪已滚落：“娘娘世袭公主，出身正统，臣妾焉能相比？”
“更何况……臣妾孤零在此，无亲无靠，无沾无故，能有今日福分，已是上天垂怜。岂敢不知尊卑有序，妄生僭越之念？”
“还请娘娘勿信小人之言！臣妾但有不是，请娘娘责罚，臣妾不敢有半点越雷池之想！”
content_en:
"Wait!"
Shi Ziqi, who followed the eunuch into the palace to listen to the announcement, walked through the winding corridor of the palace and suddenly stopped someone to avoid him.
"Who are you? How come I haven't seen you before?"
The person came with a food box in his hand and squatted down as a Wanfu. He spoke in a charming voice, which made Shi Ziqi's heart skip a beat: "Back to the prince, your servant Wenxiu is the maid in front of Concubine Rong. She was recently elected to the palace, so the prince doesn't know about it."
"Oh, that's it." Shi Ziqi responded, but without stopping, he hurried away with the eunuch. My heart is like a lake mirror, suddenly swept into a blue and green, causing ripples layer by layer, and my mood is uneasy.
"Could it be that my spiritual power has faded?"
Gu Heyan sat quietly and practiced, using the method of controlling sound to transmit sounds, and summoned his mount Clouded Leopard Mushroom, but he never showed up. He murmured to himself: "Since I was invaded by a beetle, even my memory has been damaged. Is it true that as the fourth prince said, I still need to cultivate for a few days and wait for my spiritual power to recover before I can think of revenge?"
"Alas... I wonder how Grandpa, Mushroom, and Little Shibeg are doing now?" Gu Heyan closed his eyes and sighed, and the deep conversation he had with his master reappeared in his mind.
Being invaded by the beetle and devouring his soul, the lonely crane and goose seemed to be pulled by a ghost, falling into a bottomless black hole, falling continuously and involuntarily. In a daze, he felt that his soul had left his body, and figures around him seemed to be walking towards him.
"Is it Huiyun?" he asked. The figure shook but didn't respond. "Is it grandma? Is it grandpa?..." The figure also shook and did not answer. Until he burst into tears, a figure that looked like a master came out. Lone Crane Yan stepped forward to hug him, but he was in vain.
Gu Heyan tried his best to shout: "Master, is it you? Where have you been? My disciple is here to look for you."
Master Huijue smiled, and the ethereal echo echoed in the darkness: "He Yan, I haven't gone anywhere, I am just exploring myself."
Gu Heyan asked again: "Master, after death, can a family be reunited again?"
"I miss Huiyun, I miss grandma, and I miss you too!"
The master smiled softly: "Silly boy, you are just talking nonsense! You will be fine. You were just invaded by evil poison, and you were temporarily weak, your mind was confused, and you fell into an illusion."
"Master, is there really a black hole in the world that can swallow everything and is so deep that even gods are afraid of it?"
"Master, have you seen my uncle?"
At this moment, a maid came into the room carrying a food box and interrupted his thoughts: "Lone Immortal, Concubine Rong sent me to give you a bite of cake."
"Thank you very much. Please also tell Concubine Rong not to send any more, there are too many." Gu Heyan warned with a smile.
"My slave has taken note of it." The visitor knelt down and said, "The empress said that Gu Xian's body still needs to be nursed back to health, but if there is something delicious, she will taste it before sending her slave to bring it. Please also ask the immortal not to refuse, but to eat as much as you can." After saying this, he raised his head and glanced at Gu Heyan, and quickly lowered his head.
Seeing those sapphire-like eyes, Gu Heyan's heart moved, and he thought to himself: "This girl looks very familiar... Where have I seen her before?" He said, "That's all thanks. Please tell Concubine Rong that if she is in good health, I will go and express my gratitude in person." After saying this, he thought about it secretly, but could not remember when he had seen this person. He shook his head helplessly and sighed: "Oh, I've been hurt a lot, and I can't remember many things!"
The fourth prince ordered Shi Ziqi to pay homage to Guheyan as a father and son, and earnestly told him: "Qi'er, you must treat Guxian as you treat me. You must obey your orders in everything and never be rude!" How dare Shiziqi disobey and keep making promises.
Returning to the palace, Prince Qi vomited his bitterness: "... I only respond to everything with a yes, but now it's so good that I can't get rid of the hard work of laboring and military edicts! What should I do?"
Sunu smiled when he heard this and advised: "Your Highness, what you said is wrong!"
"Compared to sitting in mourning, sitting in a deep palace, and being an imperial minister, that should be a good job!"
Shi Ziqi nodded slightly: "That's true."
"But having said that, that place has poor mountains and rivers, and the wilderness has not been transformed. I'm afraid I will have to suffer some hardships. It would be great if I could bring a monkey with me on the way."
Just as Su Nu was about to dissuade her, Prince Qi suddenly gave him a high-five: "That's right! I bumped into a woman today who is very beautiful. Su Nu, you must make a plan for me and let me take her with me on the road."
Su Nu smiled: "May I ask, Your Highness, which family the girl is from?"
"Concubine Rong is a close attendant, whose nickname is Axiu."
"This..." Su Nu frowned: "It's only one day, I'm afraid it won't work!"
Shi Ziqi's face darkened, he took out his snuff bottle and took a sip, and said in a dark voice: "Think carefully, there is still one day left. If you succeed, you will be rewarded. If not, I will send you to Yecheng! You will be more depressed than me!"
That night, the fourth princess visited Ci'an Palace with heavy gifts to visit Rong Yue.
Rong Yue walked out of the palace with surprise on her face: "If the Queen has an order, she can just send someone here. How can I go there in person? If the Emperor knows about this, how can I afford it?"
The fourth princess smiled slightly: "Concubine Rong said it before."
"Concubine Rong and Gu Xianren are now the most favored people around the emperor. Who doesn't know that?"
"As the saying goes, a Taoist mother is more precious than her son. Concubine Rong is pregnant now. How can she limit her future? Since I am the queen, I should come to visit in person. If not, wouldn't the emperor blame me for not knowing the general shape?"
Rong Yue made a move to bow, but was held back by the fourth princess. The fourth princess held his hand and walked into Ci'an Palace like sisters. As she walked, she said, "Why do we, sisters, have to pay attention to those false etiquettes? It's just a matter of showing our dignity!" Rong Yue said repeatedly: "How dare you, how dare you! My sister is the queen and I am the concubine. We still need to be polite."
"Alas..." After hearing this, the fourth princess actually took out a handkerchief and wiped her eyes, looking sad.
"Sister, what's going on? My sister is panicking." Rong Yue asked in shock.
The fourth princess put away the handkerchief: "Hey, my sister has seen through it all, and I really can't hold my breath. No wonder people outside say that you are the real master of the palace, and we, mother and son, will give way sooner or later!"
Rong Yue's face turned pale when she heard this, and she immediately knelt down and said, "The queen has broken this slave!
